title: At-Risk Extension and Hardship Review Criteria — Property Charge Advance Repayment
content:
Two criteria sets attach to Property Charge Advance Repayment arrangements: the at-risk criteria, which are set only for the At-Risk Extension, and the financial hardship review, which is available under every arrangement.

## At-risk criteria

| Arrangement | Youngest borrower's minimum age (years) | Qualifying critical circumstances | Months between reviews | Evidence required | Monthly installment during the extension (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lump-Sum Repayment | 0 (not applicable) | None | 0 | Not applicable | 0.00 |
| Repayment Plan - 12 Months | 0 (not applicable) | None | 0 | Not applicable | 0.00 |
| Repayment Plan - 24 Months | 0 (not applicable) | None | 0 | Not applicable | 0.00 |
| Repayment Plan - 36 Months | 0 (not applicable) | None | 0 | Not applicable | 0.00 |
| Repayment Plan - 60 Months | 0 (not applicable) | None | 0 | Not applicable | 0.00 |
| At-Risk Extension | 80 | Terminal illness; long-term physical disability; unique occupancy need | 12 | A physician statement or a disability award | 0.00 |

The At-Risk Extension's entry criteria are a youngest borrower aged at least 80 and a critical circumstance that is documented.

## Hardship review

| Arrangement | Financial hardship review available | Evidence for the review |
|---|---|---|
| Lump-Sum Repayment | Yes | Income and expense statement |
| Repayment Plan - 12 Months | Yes | Income and expense statement |
| Repayment Plan - 24 Months | Yes | Income and expense statement |
| Repayment Plan - 36 Months | Yes | Income and expense statement |
| Repayment Plan - 60 Months | Yes | Income and expense statement |
| At-Risk Extension | Yes | Income and expense statement |

A hardship review may shorten or lengthen the band-assigned term within the offered plans.

### Hypothetical age readings

| Youngest borrower's age (hypothetical) | Meets the minimum age of 80 |
|---|---|
| 79 | No |
| 80 | Yes |
| 86 | Yes |

The age test is one of two conditions; a documented critical circumstance from the list above is also required. Where a loan has two borrowers, the age read is that of the younger one. The ages shown are illustrative only.
